risks.note: Management states under THREATS that "the gradual exit from the educational publishing division may temporarily impact revenue and operational scale during the transition period", while the businesses meant to replace it are still only at feasibility-assessment stage.
risks.risk: Legacy business wind-down with no replacement revenue yet in place

risks.note: Management flags that "identifying the right opportunity and successfully executing a pivot requires clear strategic vision, sustained capital investment, and cultural transformation within the organization" - i.e. the strategy depends on capital and capability the company has not yet demonstrated.
risks.risk: Execution risk on an unproven pivot

risks.note: The MD&A concedes that "Sectors under consideration, particularly digital services and consumer platforms, are highly competitive and require agility, technological competence, and brand trust to scale effectively" - none of which the company claims today.
risks.risk: Entry into highly competitive digital/consumer sectors without an established position

risks.note: Management notes that "Entering new industries may require adherence to new regulatory frameworks, licensing norms, and compliance standards", adding compliance cost and approval risk to any diversification.

The business is delivered through state and central schemes (Andhra Pradesh KAPU Welfare Development Corporation, ESDM under the Ministry of IT, NBCFDC, Chhattisgarh State Skill Development Authority, Paschim Banga Society for Skill Development, Rajasthan State Livelihood Development Corporation) and the MD&A outlook rests on Union Budget allocations, while the cautionary statement names "government regulations, revision in government policies, taxation" among the factors outside the Company's control.
risks.risk: Dependence on government skilling programmes and budget policy

risks.note: Auditor observation: "Advance for project development of Rs 19,98,87,156/- (Other Non-Current Assets) remains unconfirmed/unreconciled for a prolonged period, with no independent recoverability assessment on record" (Auditor's Report para 8; Note 6) - a recoverability and asset-quality risk on what is by far the largest carried item flagged in this bundle.
risks.risk: Large project-development advance carried unconfirmed and unreconciled

risks.note: Auditor observation on investments in unquoted equity shares (Rs 39.50 lakh): the company's name does not appear as a shareholder in the records of PremColorChem Pvt Ltd and Vishesh Developers Pvt Ltd, the investment in Rock Eagle Portfolio Services Pvt Ltd is unrecoverable as that company stands struck off since 2019, and Adhunik Technology Pvt Ltd has negative net worth (Auditor's Report para 7; Note 4).
risks.risk: Unquoted investments whose ownership and recoverability are in doubt

risks.note: "No Fixed Asset Register maintained and no physical verification report available", which the report says impacts the register-maintenance requirement and the safeguarding-of-assets representation in the Directors' Responsibility Statement; the secretarial audit also asks for verification of the quarterly Statement of Deviation/Variation in use of proceeds (Reg. 32 LODR) and the monitoring/utilisation certificate for preferential allotments, and carries prior-year MR-3 qualifications (IICA databank registration, an inconsistent DIR-12 cessation date, missing share certificates/MGT-14 for the Shikshan School investment, unfiled MGT-14).

sk.overview: The company is positioned in the modular exhibition stands industry serving the Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Exhibitions (MICE) sector in India. Modular exhibition stands are flexible and reusable display structures used by businesses to showcase their brands, products and services at trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, expos and promotional events. Unlike traditional custom-built stands that are typically designed for one-time use, modular stands are made from prefabricated components that can be assembled, dismantled and reconfigured multiple times based on event requirements.
